summary: Frontend PIN login flow tested end-to-end on FitForge. Login page renders correctly with logo, title, subtitle and 6 PIN inputs. Wrong PIN (123456) shows 'Incorrect PIN' error and clears inputs. Correct PIN 858608 auto-submits, calls /api/auth/login with hardcoded credentials, and redirects to the dashboard where user data (BMI, BMR, deficit, streak, weight projection, etc.) loads successfully. Pre-registered test user via POST /api/auth/register before testing.

critical_code_review_comments: Security: PIN (858608) and credentials (adityabhatnagar08@gmail.com / Asdfghjkl123@) are hardcoded in the frontend bundle in LoginPage.jsx. Anyone can read the bundle via DevTools and obtain the real account password. This is a critical anti-pattern - the PIN provides zero security here. Consider a backend-issued session or at least a server-side PIN check that returns a token.
Recharts responsive container width/height=-1 warnings should be fixed by ensuring parent has explicit height/minHeight.
